functionReview.providerFromTarget: Leading provider prefix restricts discovery; embedded provider-like name does not.
functionReview.SessionBridge.constructor: Nonempty provider collection; rejects invalid collections.
functionReview.SessionBridge.discover: Provider selection, partial/total failure, empty healthy result, non-Error rejection, timestamp ordering, opt-in usage, no adapter-array mutation.
functionReview.SessionBridge.create: Valid trimmed prompt and cwd routed once; invalid input rejected before provider access.
functionReview.SessionBridge.archive: Exact resolved target; ambiguous/invalid target rejected; failure propagated once.
functionReview.SessionBridge.rename: Name validation/trimming, resolved target, no mutation on ambiguous/invalid input, failure propagation.
functionReview.SessionBridge.send: Exact identities among decoys, missing/partial rejection, notification metadata, no retry or relay.
functionReview.SessionBridge.ask: Exact session/message/options, independent default deadlines, fresh request IDs, exactly one delegation, no retry or relay.
functionReview.SessionBridge.#resolve: Full/native/session ID and name matching, prefix routing, ambiguity candidates and missing-target diagnostics, validation before discovery.
functionReview.SessionBridge.#provider: Unknown provider produces a public error without consulting others.
functionReview.buildPeerEnvelope: Input type and length boundaries; origin/trust, authorization disclaimer, reply mode, no-relay instructions and content boundaries.
functionReview.WAGA_SESSION_INSTRUCTIONS: Native-session context, user override, discovery/send/ask commands, full-ID preference, no authorization/automatic forwarding. Text only, not model compliance.
